summary: MV-2023-288 is a source-record index for the NM-84 rat exposure bridge between two dosing lots. Doses, vehicles, sample matrix and analytical limits belong to the signed dosing plan and assay-method records under M23/BIO/06630; no numerical exposure or independent run acceptance is reproduced here. Comparable exposure allowed Nimbravelle to retain the original efficacy interpretation, as reported in MV-2023-288_Readout_112723_R1.pptx.
